ghidra_config.why: Stock Ghidra's own MIPS:LE:32:default (the R3000A is MIPS I) under the PsxLoader extension's PS-EXE loader (auto-selected; the loader only lays out the image). Our import uses PSX:LE:32:default (native/languages/psx: this MIPS plus the GTE). Ghidra on PSX:LE:32:default (its own or ours) finds only 1011 functions (recall 0.5844); the cause is not established (the extension keys its function-start patterns to MIPS); MIPS finds 2012 (0.9205), the recorded stock numbers.
Stock ELF loader, R5900 language; stripped ELF, the same file our import reads.
GameCubeLoader extension (DOL sections at their load addresses), Gekko/Broadway.
Stock ELF loader with the emotionengine-reloaded R5900 language; stripped ELF (llvm-strip --strip-all), the same file our import reads.

XEXLoaderWV extension. Our language, PowerPC:BE:64:Xenon-32addr, is built by native/languages/xenon/install.sh (A2 + VMX128) and is not a Ghidra module (no Module.manifest), so stock Ghidra cannot load it; A2ALT-32addr (A2 + AltiVec) is the stock language it extends. VMX128 instructions do not decode there, so Ghidra's flow stops at them. The MSVC map is not given to either tool.
Stock ELF loader (auto-selected) on the decrypted eboot.elf (e_type 0xFE00, SCE executable), ARM:LE:32:v8 as our import.

NdsLoader (NTRGhidra) extension, ARM9 CPU; ARM9 overlays loaded into overlay spaces (our import also analyses them) but not scored. The loader takes one CPU per program: the ARM7 binary our import also analyses (161 KB) is not loaded, a small advantage to Ghidra.
gba-ghidra-loader extension (GBALoader), forced because the ROM has no container a stock loader recognises.
